newsitem.title: LEBANON: LEBANON SAYS IT IS READY FOR ARAB GAMES.
newsitem.headline: LEBANON SAYS IT IS READY FOR ARAB GAMES.

text.p: Lebanon said on Wednesday it was ready to host the Arab Games starting on July 12 although a hall intended for indoor sports would not be ready.

Outdoor events would be held in a 50,000-seat stadium which was nearing completion and indoor sports would take place in different facilities around Beirut, Sports Minister Jean Obeid told a news conference.
"Lebanon is ready for the Arab games which will be a great Arab event in Beirut," Obeid said.
Zeid Khyami, Sports Minister director-general, said 18 Arab states had confirmed their participation but the organising committee was awaiting confirmation from three other countries.
Khyami said these included Kuwait, whose government had told the organising committee it might boycott the games if Iraq participated though it had made no final decision.
The new open-air stadium, which has taken four years to build, replaces one destroyed during Israel's 1982 invasion of Lebanon.
Delays in building the stadium caused the postponement of the Games which were originally scheduled for last September.
Arab countries pledged $120 million in 1993 to rebuild Beirut's destroyed sports facilities.
